final: WITH staff_counts AS (SELECT staff_id, COUNT(rental_id) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS total_count FROM staff_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.rental_count, CAST(sc.rental_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM staff_counts sc CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_count FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.rental_count, s.share, a.average_count FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND s.rental_count > a.average_count) SELECT AVG(average_count), AVG(share), AVG(rental_count - average_count) FROM kept
